fact: Airtel Tchad presented to the regulator ARCEP on 18 September 2025 a network infrastructure plan of XOF 50 billion (about USD 83.3 million) running to June 2026, which the article itself calls a declaration of intent with no firm financing commitment.
title: Tchad : Airtel va investir plus de 80 millions USD pour renforcer son réseau télécom
